description: Phase 09 Prompt 27 — context budget optimization. An additive, advisory best-effort context packer that recovers budget wasted by the baseline apply_context_budget (which breaks at the first overflowing item). It uses the same deterministic priority order (review tier -> recency -> confidence -> source_ref) and the same per-item / total budget bounds, but skips an oversized item and continues packing the rest. It preserves every kept item's review tier, confidence class, source reference, and freshness, and adds budget-drop coverage warnings so a sacrificed item is surfaced, never silently lost. Read-only and advisory: it never modifies the authoritative apply_context_budget, never exceeds the budget, assembles no final answer, and persists nothing (no DB writes).
